response: Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans, giving your team a faster way to stay organized. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now capture the exact configuration you rely on and return to it in a single click. Set up a filtered list for overdue tasks, a sorted board for this week's priorities, or a grouped view by assignee, then save it for instant access later. Each user can save up to 50 views, so there's plenty of room to organize work across every project you're part of. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to align on the same filters, sorting, and grouping without asking teammates to recreate your setup from scratch. Whether you manage a small team or a large organization, Saved Views helps everyone work from the same page, literally. This feature is live now and ready to use across every workspace on a paid plan. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
